plugins.name: fcxo-toolkit
plugins.description: Operational toolkit for fractional executives (CEO/CMO/CSO/CTO/COO/CFO): find and win clients (research, qualify, outreach, call prep, proposals), deliver and retain (status updates, decision reports, onboarding plans, renewal reviews, branded client reports), market yourself, and run the back-office of a solo practice. Role-aware, works standalone, shell-free so it runs the same in Claude Code and Claude Cowork, anchored on a lightweight markdown practice workspace.

skills.name: fcxo-book-call
skills.description: Turn 'we should talk' into a held slot and a drafted reply: read the calendar, hold the time on your own calendar with no guests, and draft the message that proposes it. Use when the user wants to book a call, schedule a meeting, find a slot, set up the review call, propose times, or get a call in the diary.
headings: fcxo-book-call - a held slot and the reply that proposes it
The one hard rule: the hold carries no guests
Resolve the company and read the context
Find the calendar, then read it
skills.description_zh: 读取日历并在自己的日历预留无参会者的时间段，再起草建议该时间的回复；用于安排通话、会议、复盘及查找可用时段。

skills.name: fcxo-brainstorm
skills.description: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or offer, checkpointing every answer to a capture file so nothing is lost. Use to stress-test a plan, run a brainstorm or discovery session, or when the user says 'grill me'.
headings: fcxo-brainstorm – grill the user, checkpoint everything
The capture file is the whole point
Setup (do this BEFORE the first question)
skills.description_zh: 围绕计划、决策或报价持续访谈和追问，将每次回答保存到捕获文件；用于压力测试计划、头脑风暴或需求探索。

skills.name: fcxo-brand
skills.description: Set up or adjust the visual brand for a fractional executive's documents: accent color, logo, fonts, and billing details. Use when the user wants to set up branding, change a brand color, add a logo, or match their website.
headings: fcxo-brand - your document look, set once and reused
The fallback chain (keep it one decision for the user)
skills.description_zh: 为兼职高管的文档设置或调整品牌强调色、标志、字体与开票资料，适用于初次品牌配置、改色、添加标志或匹配网站风格。

skills.name: fcxo-call-prep
skills.description: Build a one-page prep before a discovery, sales, or client call: the objective, a tight agenda, the questions to ask, and the next step to land. Use when the user wants call prep, to prep for a call, prepare for a meeting, a discovery call agenda, or sales call preparation.
headings: fcxo-call-prep - one page to read five minutes before the call
skills.description_zh: 为需求探索、销售或客户通话生成一页准备材料，列明目标、精简议程、要问的问题及希望达成的下一步。

skills.name: fcxo-call-summary
skills.description: Turn call notes or a transcript into action items, a follow-up email draft, and an internal summary. Use when the user wants to summarize a call, process notes, write a follow-up, or recap a meeting.
headings: fcxo-call-summary – from messy notes to action items and a follow-up
skills.description_zh: 将通话笔记或转录整理为行动项、跟进邮件草稿和内部摘要，用于会议回顾与跟进准备。

skills.name: fcxo-case-study
skills.description: Turn a finished or milestone-passing engagement into an anonymized, reusable win story that feeds proposals and posts. Use when the user wants a case study, a win story, to write up an engagement, a success story, or to turn this client work into marketing material.
headings: Step 1 - Read the record (before asking anything)
skills.description_zh: 将已结束或达到里程碑的客户项目整理为匿名、可复用的成功案例，供提案与宣传文章使用。

skills.name: fcxo-decision-report
skills.description: Build a board-ready decision memo (situation, options, recommendation, risks) framed in the user's role lens. Use when the user wants a decision report, board memo, exec brief, or options analysis.
headings: fcxo-decision-report – a memo a board can act on
skills.description_zh: 依据用户的职务视角生成可供董事会审阅的决策备忘录，涵盖现状、方案、建议和风险；用于决策报告、高管简报与选项分析。

skills.name: fcxo-help
skills.description: List the FCxO Toolkit skills grouped by job, explain when to use each, and answer a stated goal with the right skill or the sequence of skills that gets there. Use when the user asks what can this do, list the skills, what skills are there, how do I use the toolkit, where do I start, what comes next, which skill for X, or how do I win this client / get paid / set up my practice.
headings: fcxo-help – what the toolkit does and which skill to use
Always read the live skills (never a hardcoded list)
skills.description_zh: 按工作类型列出 FCxO Toolkit 技能并解释用途，根据目标推荐技能或执行顺序；用于了解工具包、选择起点与后续步骤，以及获取客户、收款或建立业务实践。

skills.name: fcxo-init
skills.description: First-time setup of a fractional executive's practice workspace. Use when the user wants to set up their practice, initialize an FCxO workspace, or get started with the FCxO Toolkit.
headings: fcxo-init – set up your practice workspace
Step 1 – Check for an existing workspace
Step 2 – Gather setup details (one batched ask)
skills.description_zh: 首次初始化兼职高管的业务工作区，用于建立实践空间或开始使用 FCxO Toolkit。

skills.name: fcxo-invoice
skills.description: Generate a branded invoice for a fractional executive from an engagement and their billing details. Use when the user wants to create an invoice, bill a client, or generate a bill.
headings: fcxo-invoice – a branded invoice, ready to print
skills.description_zh: 根据客户项目和开票资料为兼职高管生成带品牌样式的发票，用于客户收费与账单制作。

skills.name: fcxo-learn-skill
skills.description: Turn a procedure into a reusable skill you can call with a slash command. Its best input is a written SOP, and the path to one is a complete argument. Use when the user says learn a skill, build me a skill, turn this SOP into a skill, make a skill from this doc or example or url, or save what we just did as a skill. Researches how the task is done well, writes skills/<name>/SKILL.md, and tells the user how to upload it to their Claude account.
headings: fcxo-learn-skill – turn a procedure into a skill
1. Take the input. An SOP is the best one, and its path is a complete argument
2. Research how others do it (parallel subagents)
4. Close the gaps with a short interview
5. Name it for what it does
7. Write it to `skills/<name>/`, then tell the user how to upload it
If all the user wants is a cadence, they need no skill
skills.description_zh: 将流程、SOP、文档、示例或链接整理为可用斜杠命令调用的可复用技能，研究任务的良好做法并写入 skills/<name>/SKILL.md，再说明如何上传到 Claude 账户；书面 SOP 是其优先输入。

skills.name: fcxo-log-message
skills.description: Record an incoming or sent message from a client or a lead (email, DM, note) into its communications thread. Use when the user wants to log a message, save a client email, log an email from a prospect, record what a client or a lead said, file an inbound enquiry, or update a conversation thread.
skills.description_zh: 将客户或潜客收到、发出的邮件、私信和笔记记入对应沟通线程，用于保存询盘、记录对方表述或更新对话档案。

skills.name: fcxo-new-client
skills.description: Add a new client or engagement to a fractional executive's practice workspace. Use when the user wants to add a client, onboard one, or start a new engagement, project, or retainer.
headings: fcxo-new-client – add a client or engagement
skills.description_zh: 在兼职高管业务工作区新增客户或服务项目，适用于客户入驻、新项目或长期顾问服务开始。

skills.name: fcxo-onboarding-plan
skills.description: Build a 30-60-90 plan (Diagnose - Design - Deliver) for a new engagement's first quarter, grounded in its actual scope and framed in the user's role lens. Use when the user wants an onboarding plan, a 30-60-90, a first 90 days plan, a kickoff plan, or an engagement start plan.
headings: fcxo-onboarding-plan - the first-quarter plan a client expects at kickoff
Step 1 - Read what the engagement already says
skills.name_hint: fcxo · 入门/入职 · 规划
skills.description_zh: 依据新项目实际范围和用户职务视角制定首季度30/60/90天计划，按诊断、设计、交付组织入驻与启动工作。

skills.name: fcxo-outreach
skills.description: Draft personalized cold, warm, referral, or network-touch outreach in the user's own voice. Use when the user wants to draft outreach, write a cold email, message a prospect, ask for a referral, or check in with a warm contact they haven't spoken to in a while.
headings: fcxo-outreach – outreach in your voice, ready to send yourself
skills.description_zh: 以用户自身语气起草个性化陌生、熟悉、转介绍或关系维护联系消息，用于潜客邮件、请求推荐和久未联系对象的问候。

skills.name: fcxo-pipeline-review
skills.description: Weekly pipeline and client-portfolio review for a fractional executive: prioritize leads, flag risks, and produce a short action plan. Use when the user wants to review their pipeline or plan their week.
headings: fcxo-pipeline-review – what to chase, what to protect, what to drop
skills.description_zh: 为兼职高管开展每周销售管道和客户组合复盘，排列线索优先级、标记风险并生成简短行动计划。

skills.name: fcxo-post
skills.description: Draft or finalize a short professional post in the fractional executive's own voice, enforcing a voice and style guide that learns from feedback. Use when the user wants to write a post, draft social content, finalize a post, or work on their personal brand.
headings: fcxo-post – a post worth reading, in your voice
The voice guide is the source of truth
Self-learning (capture feedback into the voice guide)
skills.description_zh: 按兼职高管自身语气起草或定稿简短专业文章，使用随反馈调整的语气与风格指南；适用于社交内容和个人品牌建设。

skills.name: fcxo-proposal
skills.description: Draft the proposal, SOW, or letter of agreement that converts a qualified lead into an engagement: the buyer's problem in their words, a concrete scope with clear edges, one price anchored to the user's offers, and one next step. Use when the user wants to write a proposal, draft an SOW / statement of work, prepare a letter of agreement, send terms, or price an engagement.
headings: fcxo-proposal - the document that wins the deal and sets the scope
Step 1 - Read the context (this is the job; do not ask for what the folder holds)
Step 2 - Fill genuine gaps (rarely, and only one batched question)
Draft only, and where this hands off
skills.description_zh: 起草将合格线索转为服务项目的提案、SOW 或协议函，以买方表述说明问题、界定具体范围、提供基于用户服务报价的单一价格和下一步；用于提案、条款准备与项目定价。

skills.name: fcxo-prospect-research
skills.description: Research a target company and decision-maker before outreach or a sales call, and produce an actionable brief tuned to the user's role. Use when the user wants to research a company or prospect, or prep before reaching out.
headings: fcxo-prospect-research – actionable intel before you reach out
skills.description_zh: 在销售联系或通话前研究目标企业和决策者，生成符合用户职务视角、可用于行动的简报。

skills.name: fcxo-qualify
skills.description: Qualify a lead for a fractional executive: assess fit, urgency, and budget, recommend an engagement shape, and give a go/no-go. Use when the user wants to qualify a lead or decide whether to pursue a client.
headings: fcxo-qualify – fit, urgency, budget, and a clear verdict
skills.description_zh: 评估兼职高管潜客的匹配程度、紧迫性与预算，建议服务项目形式并给出是否继续跟进的判断。

skills.name: fcxo-renewal-review
skills.description: Prepare the renewal checkpoint for an active engagement: an evidence-backed results-vs-plan review for the client plus an honest internal read on whether and on what terms to renew. Use when the user wants a renewal review, a QBR or quarterly business review, to prepare a renewal conversation, or asks should I renew this client.
headings: fcxo-renewal-review - protect and expand recurring revenue
skills.description_zh: 为现有项目准备续约或季度业务复盘，以证据对比结果与计划，并提供内部对是否续约及续约条件的判断；用于 QBR 和续约谈话准备。

skills.name: fcxo-reply
skills.description: Draft one reply inside an existing client thread, using only the logged thread as context and mirroring its tone and language. Draft only - you send it. Use when the user wants to reply to a client, answer an email in a thread, or continue a conversation.
headings: fcxo-reply – one fluent reply, inside the thread
skills.description_zh: 仅依据已记录的客户对话线程起草一条回复，匹配原有语气和语言；只生成草稿，由用户发送。

skills.name: fcxo-report
skills.description: Render an existing document (proposal, report, deliverable) as a branded, self-contained HTML file beside its markdown, or compose the report first when none exists. Use when the user wants a client report, an assessment report, a branded document, to render a proposal or deliverable, or to turn a memo into a client PDF.
headings: fcxo-report - the deliverable, composed and rendered
Step 0 - Resolve what you are rendering (do this before anything else)
Step 1 - Gather the material (compose mode only)
Step 2 - Compose (markdown, the durable record; compose mode only)
skills.description_zh: 将现有提案、报告或交付文档渲染为与 Markdown 并列保存、带品牌样式且自包含的 HTML；没有文档时先撰写报告，适用于客户报告、评估材料和备忘录转客户 PDF。

skills.name: fcxo-research-form
skills.description: Build a short, typed questionnaire as a platform-neutral form spec ready to paste into any forms tool, or synthesize the responses once they come back. Use when the user wants a research form, questionnaire, or survey, stakeholder questions, an employee survey, to collect input from the client's team, or to analyze survey responses.
headings: fcxo-research-form - ask once, typed and short, then read the answers honestly
Step 2 - define the audience and the promise
skills.description_zh: 生成简短且标明题目类型的平台中立问卷规范，可粘贴到表单工具；也可在收回后综合分析回答，适用于研究、利益相关者提问和员工调查。

skills.name: fcxo-setup-template
skills.description: Give a document type its look, and keep the content template and the layout matched. Works from either end: a layout designed in Claude, or a markdown template that has no layout yet. Use when the user says set up a template, add a document template, use this design for my proposals, brand my reports, make my invoices look like this, give my invoice template a design, my proposal template has no layout, or I designed a layout in Claude and want to reuse it.
headings: fcxo-setup-template - the layout, taught once and reused
Step 1 - Look at what the workspace already has
Designing the layout in Claude - what to tell the user
When the design half is already a template
Step 3 - Normalize it into the design template
Step 5 - Save the half this run built, and say who uses the pair
skills.description_zh: 为某类文档建立视觉样式并保持内容模板与版式匹配，可从 Claude 中设计的布局或没有布局的 Markdown 模板出发，复用到提案、报告和发票等。

skills.name: fcxo-status-update
skills.description: Draft a client's periodic status update from the workspace record - progress tied to engagement goals, explicit asks, risks - plus a private scope-creep check. Use when the user wants to send a status update, weekly update, client update, or progress report, or asks what should I send my client this week.
headings: fcxo-status-update - the update that keeps your value visible
Gather the period from the workspace
Scope-creep check (to the user, never in the client draft)
skills.description_zh: 根据工作区记录起草客户定期状态更新，将进展关联项目目标，列明请求与风险，并单独检查范围蔓延；用于周报与客户进度报告。

skills.name: fcxo-write-sop
skills.description: Use when the user says write down my process, document this procedure, capture how I do this, turn this into an SOP, or I do this every week and want it on paper, AND when the user hands a bare goal with no procedure yet: write me an SOP for X, set up a procedure for onboarding a client, automate lead generation. It grades what it is given: rich evidence gets captured into sop/<Procedure> - SOP.md with few questions and no web research; a bare goal gets researched and built into the same file as a proposed procedure the user refines by running it.
headings: fcxo-write-sop – write down a procedure, or build one you want
3. Capture: find the evidence before you ask anything
4. Ask only what the evidence leaves open
5. Build: research and the user's specifics, for a thin goal
7. Say what can be done with it now
How this differs from its neighbours
skills.description_zh: 将已有过程证据整理为 sop/<Procedure> - SOP.md；资料充分时少量提问且不联网研究，仅有目标时先研究并提出流程供用户执行完善，适用于记录过程、制定 SOP 和周期性工作流程。

headings: Or from a local clone (run from the repo folder, or pass its path)
Or load it for a single session without installing
Render contract (performed by fcxo-invoice / fcxo-report / fcxo-brand; layouts installed by fcxo-setup-template)
